ValidationRule.description: Require Case Term for Help Desk, Student Business Services, and Financial Aid when closing cases excluding Status Closed : SPAM , excluding System Administrator
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR (( CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Financial Aid" ), ( CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Student Business Services"), ( CC_Category__r.Name = "Finances (Help Desk)") ), (ISBLANK(TEXT( Case_Term__c ))), ($User.ProfileId <> "00ed00000017Iob" && $Profile.Id <> "00ed00000019z5n" && $Profile.Id <> "00ed00000019z5s" && $Profile.Id <> "00ed00000019z77"), OR( ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Cancellation"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Unresponsive"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Duplicate"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Forwarded"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: No Show"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Resolved")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SERVICE - FA/SBS - SPECIAL SUBCAT REQUIRES CASE TERM A case term is required for Financial Aid, Student Business Services, and Finances (Help Desk) cases.
